messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick thread for CityLab booth tomorrow — need final confirmations for swag pickup, speaker mic, lead-QR routing, and social asset timing. Keep it tight.
Tom - Events: Load-in confirmed 10:30am. I'll have a dolly and two volunteers.
Owen Ops: Swag pickup from warehouse at 9:15am. Box list: 120 stickers, 80 tees, 60 notebooks, 2 banner stands.
Rina (Design): Banners sized 33x80. Please avoid rolling with heavy items on top. I left grommet kit in the small zip pouch.
Sam (Growth): Lead capture plan: QR -> short form captures email + company + interest (embed, gen, private). Tag with source=citylab-booth in HubSpot.
Maya (Marketing): Good. Sam, can you also create a quick UTM for the live demo slide?
Sam (Growth): Using utm_campaign=citylab2026&utm_medium=booth.
LogiBot: Reminder: Parking pass emailed to team, lot C.
Tom - Events: AV check: podium mic + backup handheld. Owen, can you pack adapters for USB-C and MiniDisplay?
Owen Ops: Packed. Also bringing a battery pack and power strip.
Rina (Design): Social assets: 4 story frames and one hero. Can someone post the first story at 11:45am when doors open?
Maya (Marketing): I'll post the first story. Can Rina leave a quick 15s clip template for the streamer?
Rina (Design): Clip template in the kit labeled CITYLAB_SOCIAL_MR.
Maya (Marketing): Swag policy: 1 tee per attendee; stickers and notebooks free. Reserve 20 tees for speaker gifts.
Owen Ops: Noted. Where's the raffle box?
Tom - Events: Raffle box in the rolling case, clipboard + pens included.
Sam (Growth): Post-event: Sam will triage leads; Maya will draft nurture with benchmark summary. Need the final PDF by Monday.
Maya (Marketing): I'll finish benchmark PDF tonight. Keep numbers: "lower cost per token vs baseline" in the one-pager, details in the PDF.
LogiBot: Reminder: Insurance docs uploaded to vendor portal.
Maya (Marketing): Final checklist:
- Meet at dock 10:20am
- Booth ready 11:15am
- Demo slots: 1:00pm & 3:00pm
- Raffle draw 4:45pm
- Teardown 5:30pm
Tom - Events: All set. Post any late changes here. :sparkles:
